[[Vanquisher|Vanquish]] [[the Scar]]. 

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Clear the Scar in the [[Crystal Desert]] of all enemies in [[hard mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 15,000 [[Experience]]
* 2,000 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 250 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].

== Dialogues ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
; [[Zaishen Vanquish]]
: ''"Clear the Scar in the Crystal Desert of all enemies in hard mode."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = There are still threats that remain. Return when you have slain all of the foes that await you at your destination.}}

=== Reward dialogue ===
; Zehnchu
: ''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

==Notes==
*Consider acquiring the quests for [[The Arid Sea (Zaishen vanquish)|The Arid Sea]] (three days earlier) and [[Skyward Reach (Zaishen vanquish)|Skyward Reach]] (the prior quest in cycle), since you can [[Vanquisher#Larger party sizes|caravan vanquish]] all three areas consecutively with an eight-member [[party]] via [[Forgotten Guardian]].
